description: This file defines the EntityTypeUtil class, which provides utility methods for handling entity types within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to determine type relationships, retrieve descendant types, and check parent type hierarchy, mainly for generic entity types in the database.

classes.name: EntityTypeUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for dealing with entity type hierarchies, including checking type relations, retrieving descendants, and verifying parent relationships.

methods.name: isType(Collection<GenericValue>, String, GenericValue)
methods.description: Checks if any entity in the collection has a related entity of the specified type relation that matches the target type.

methods.name: getParentType(GenericValue)
methods.description: Retrieves the parent type of the given type value assuming a 'Parent<entityName>' relation.

methods.name: getDescendantTypes(GenericValue)
methods.description: Recursively collects all descendant types of the specified type value based on 'Child<entityName>' relationships.

methods.name: isType(GenericValue, GenericValue)
methods.description: Checks whether one type value is a subtype or related to another type value in the hierarchy.

methods.name: hasParentType(Delegator, String, String, String, String, String)
methods.description: Verifies whether a given type identified by its primary key has a specified parent type in the hierarchy, using a querying mechanism.
